authored_scope: EXP013 A04 final 40 explicitly scripted locations LV_161-LV_200, cumulative 200/200 source-scripted

entries.title: Market cross mislabelled trunk
entries.stakes: The Market Cross Switchbox mixes cloth-insulated legacy wires with a new market distribution ring. Identify the true feeder before vendors reconnect their equipment.

entries.title: Lantern cart seized transfer
entries.stakes: An aged isolator in the Lantern Cart Station sticks between old and new wiring. Keep the cart charger isolated while the transfer blade is reseated.

entries.title: Night watch pure clinical rail
entries.stakes: An undocumented old wire runs alongside the new Night Watch Dispensary supply. Distinguish clean medicine refrigeration from a phantom shared neutral.

entries.title: Tallow arcade archive transfer
entries.stakes: The Tallow Central Arcade archive computer still uses a brittle cloth-sheathed feeder. Transfer records to the new rail without powering its obsolete heater.

entries.title: Well booster market opening
entries.stakes: An old booster wire joins the well pump starter at a mixed-era switchboard. Stage clean-water pressure before reopening market taps at the fixed deadline.

entries.source_title: Clockface Message Room: Storm pulse timing
entries.title: Clockface pulse sequencing
entries.stakes: A legacy clock wire is coupled to the new message transmitter. Use a timed pulse to synchronize the market announcement without backfeeding the clock motor.

entries.title: Guild junior cable conversion
entries.stakes: Students at Guild Junior Workshop cannot safely use modern tools on a patched legacy cable. Test isolation and remake the transition splice before class starts.

entries.source_title: Chandler's Meeting House: Controlled load shed
entries.title: Chandler hall priority shed
entries.stakes: The Chandlers Meeting House old candle-warming circuit consumes power intended for evacuation lights. Shed heating and prove the new safety rail separately.

entries.title: Basin stack beacon return
entries.stakes: A harmless dye mist makes Basin Transfer Stack contacts appear damaged, but the warning beacon has a real open return. Distinguish residue from missing continuity.

entries.title: Rivet causeway ferry budget
entries.stakes: Colored mist obscures the Rivet Ferry Causeway load markings. Prioritize safe dock lights over the cargo hoist without cutting the ferry navigation beacon.

entries.source_title: Foxglove Aid Post: False fuse alarm
entries.title: Foxglove false fuse dye leak
entries.stakes: The Foxglove Aid Post fuse flag is stained by harmless dye, but an actual feeder trip may still be hidden. Separate visual contamination from electrical measurements.

entries.title: Dye outlet drainage dependency
entries.stakes: A bright but harmless dye leak obscures the Dye Works Outlet sump-level gauge. Prove the real drain depth before permitting the market conveyor restart.

entries.title: Basin aerator safe reset
entries.stakes: Basin Aeration Pumps have latched after a dye-stained sensor signalled an imaginary contamination event. Reset only after confirming true dissolved-air circulation.

entries.title: Weather balloon split telemetry
entries.stakes: Weather Balloon Shed has two redundant aerial power feeds, one painted by dye mist. Compare return paths before reconnecting the storm forecast transmitter.

entries.title: Basin lab substation restart
entries.stakes: A false dye alarm has kept the Basin Studies Lab's substation locked. Ensure sensor reference is clean before restoring microscope and sampling benches.

entries.source_title: Millpond Evacuation Hall: Network loop hunt
entries.title: Millpond hall hidden feedback
entries.stakes: Colored residue hides a feedback jumper in Millpond Evacuation Hall's water alarm controller. Break the actual electrical loop before declaring a safe refuge.

entries.title: Astral feeder pressure arrest
entries.stakes: Lightning has struck the Astral Feeder Vault and tripped a pneumatic cable-pressure monitor. Prove the conductor insulation before bleeding the false overpressure latch.

entries.title: Telescope rail critical dispatch
entries.stakes: The telescope access rail and instrument surge arresters compete for post-strike reserve power. Protect research sensors before moving the observation lift.

entries.title: Altitude clinic telemetry conflict
entries.stakes: Storm echoes make Altitude Medical Room report conflicting supply and patient-monitor readings. Cross-check the isolated clinical reference before switching sources.

entries.title: Night sky booth access lock
entries.stakes: The Night-Sky Supply Booth access key can energize a lightning-exposed dome conduit. Prove surge arrestor isolation before letting staff open the service cabinet.

entries.title: Mirror cooling thermal latch
entries.stakes: A lightning surge has overheated the Mirror Cooling Plant breaker near the telescope optics. Cool the thermal element without cycling the sensitive mirror drive.

entries.title: Tracking array crossfeed lock
entries.stakes: The Northern Tracking Array has a lightning-created crossfeed between two antenna amplifiers. Separate both paths before restoring precision tracking signals.

entries.title: Astronomy school feeder identity
entries.stakes: An aged label points Cedar Astronomy School's telescope classroom at the external lightning rod circuit. Trace the protected indoor route before opening the observatory.

entries.title: Stargazer dorm isolator blade
entries.stakes: A struck isolator has become sticky while the Stargazer Dormitory reserve heaters draw through its case. Protect sleeping quarters before freeing the switch.

entries.title: Dunewatch frozen cold chain
entries.stakes: Sand blown into the Dunewatch Switchfield connector interrupts refrigerated desert supplies. Clear the protected link before transferring loads to the storage spur.

entries.title: Sandline safe transit bypass
entries.stakes: A sandstorm has eroded the Sandline Transit Stop's bypass terminal. Secure the guide lighting and isolate the damaged rail before carrying passengers.

entries.title: Dune aid post voltage drift
entries.stakes: Fine sand inside the Dune First Response voltage regulator creates intermittent sags. Verify the rescue circuit separately before moving medicine refrigeration.

entries.source_title: Oasis Supply Courtyard: Limited cable reel
entries.title: Oasis courtyard short reel
entries.stakes: A sand-scoured connector forces the Oasis Supply Courtyard to re-route power around a damaged wall. Measure the only viable cable run before splicing.

entries.source_title: Aquifer Pump Vault: Staged pump sequence
entries.title: Aquifer staged pumping
entries.stakes: Sand has choked the Aquifer Pump Vault inlet and sealed the secondary pressure sensor. Prime staged filtration before enabling the deep-water pump.

entries.source_title: Storm Flag Radio Mast: Intermittent ground
entries.title: Storm flag mast earth leak
entries.stakes: A sandstorm makes the Storm Flag Radio Mast ground strap intermittently conductive. Reestablish a stable reference before sending the emergency flag warning.

entries.title: Ecology school beacon closure
entries.stakes: Desert Ecology Academy's refuge beacon has a broken return after windblown grit entered the switch. Verify lamp continuity without energizing exposed outdoor benches.

entries.title: Refuge dome capacity allocation
entries.stakes: The Coastal Refuge Dome cannot power air filtration and crowd heaters simultaneously during a sandstorm. Reserve filtered air before allocating comfort loads.

entries.title: Beacon row flooded archive
entries.stakes: The Beacon Row Transformer archive control tray has been drenched by a flooded stairwell. Isolate the submerged reference before restoring neighborhood records power.

entries.title: Skybridge transit opening gate
entries.stakes: A flooded stairwell blocks Skybridge Transit Deck access just as the last service carriage arrives. Restore route lamps without energizing the submerged landing.

entries.source_title: Tower Eight Clinic: Storm pulse timing
entries.title: Tower Eight clinic pulse slot
entries.stakes: Water in the tower stairwell has reached a clinic antenna conduit. Use the brief dry-power window to move medical lights without backfeeding the wet riser.

entries.title: Roof garden splice isolation
entries.stakes: A wet stairwell cable serves Roof Garden Market's rooftop produce coolers. Protect the lift shaft and splice only the dry branch before reopening stalls.

entries.source_title: Basement Sump Plant: Controlled load shed
entries.title: Basement sump emergency shedding
entries.stakes: Basement Sump Plant controls are overwhelmed by stairwell floodwater. Shed nonessential lobby loads so sump capacity can keep the exit passage clear.

entries.title: Beacon aerial generator choices
entries.stakes: A storm has severed the Beacon Aerial Loft antenna return while stairwells fill with water. Reserve generator output for a reliable emergency broadcast.

entries.title: Terrace school false pressure
entries.stakes: Floodwater in the Terrace Evening School stairwell makes its pressure switch trip even after the classroom drains. Verify dry contacts before relighting the school.

entries.title: Residents emergency dispatch
entries.stakes: The Residents Emergency Hub must supply rescue lifts, dry exits and radio warnings from a constrained flooded terrace feeder. Select essential service before recovery.
